The fix uses actual unsettled due beats/target with sleep/occupation/write/location rechecks and clipped-step fallback, not a new clock or a universal elapsed accumulator. Final coordinator browser supersedes opening blocked status:349minutesin13.4s, dawn knowledge shown, actual Save/reload/Export/Import and zero page errors. ids: battle structural runner;126differentials;controlled envelope versus create_save
reviews.classification: complete historical visibility, wait, workflow or battle receipt with actual late corrections and proof gaps
reviews.disposition: The staged runner preserves exact legacy road/party/sluice owners, ordered stop/effect/guard/helper hooks and schema6cohort delegation; field care is an observer, not a newly unified battle. Its126equivalence cases across five seeds compare plans/property order, real persistExpansionPlan bytes in a controlled envelope and JSON reload continuation. This is not actual main.create_save byte equivalence, every source fight or a natural browser route. Frozen implementations are test-only and depend on current relative modules; HEAD alone does not freeze those dependencies. Ordinal RNG remains the explicit legacy compatibility path; keyed port availability does not convert old draw semantics. Range/morale/choice UI/canon fight policy and deeper declarative operations remain step2, not implemented by structural extraction. The181focused checks/build/arch pass leaves desktop Reports/persistence comparison and full combined suite distinct. A proposed systems-register patch is not an applied register update.

ids: located hit proposals;extreme-onlyblock;seeded road proof;missing frontierparts
reviews.classification: complete historical visibility, wait, workflow or battle receipt with actual late corrections and proof gaps
reviews.disposition: The road fixture browser proves aimed hit display, slot armor, part injuries affecting later odds/speed, mid-fight reload and literal Export/Import at its input. It seeds amplified rival attack and equipped gear through native owners; it does not show naturally earned early-game injury rates. Head/body/arm/leg mappings,8/18/30thresholds,1.4/1/0.75scales and aim costs are proposals/world dials rather than universally fixed biology. Only the extreme ladder rung blocks per the stated direction. Default body has no part row, shields return before location, foes do not aim and all wounds are announced. The real frontier harm-world lacks parts, so its stored injuries do not act and harmPart can throw; the host's default-row workaround does not close that owning ladder gap. Preserve this named integration request and actual limited floor; the final bundle/full-suite reference requires its own receipt before reuse, not a guessed hash or global fight-complete claim.
